description: The app is served by the localhost sidecar and the Rust window navigation policy pins the exact runtime port. Window IPC supports the merged titlebar; the Library export command is bounded by its mandatory native Save dialog and accepts no destination path from the webview. Restart remains bundled-origin only. shell:allow-open hands a clicked web link to the system browser; the shell plugin's default open scope admits only http(s), mailto and tel URLs, and no other shell command is allowed.
